verdict.rationale: Riskified documents a public REST API that can be called directly over HTTP. It covers order review (/decide, /submit, /advise), chargebacks, login/account-secure decisions, HMAC-SHA256 request authentication and webhook notifications with retries. Optional SDKs, a self-service Integration Console and an llms.txt with .md-suffixed doc pages make it practical for agents to consume. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (every probed path returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as described, and evidence of self-serve API access rather than team-assisted onboarding.
